The LunarG loader ignores those variables in elevated processes (PLATFORMS.md §7.4.1) and GitHub's Windows runners are elevated. The control did not reach its observation, so it asserts NOTHING about the gate — in particular it is not evidence that the gate cannot fail. This lane's falsifier is the loader-independent decline-probe control, which is mandatory and cannot be skipped.

  expected substring: "passed the §7.2 capability gate"
